mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is active whenever the rate has been falling for at least 90 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 90 days, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.8% in a single month, it indicates accelerating labor market weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.8% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates a broad-based demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions (defined by industrial production growth above 2.0% annually), a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the past three months indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE has declined for at least 90 days, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it indicates an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in the federal funds rate and the consumer price index (CPI) over the past month indicates a hawkish monetary policy response to inflation, triggering equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing-driven expansions (defined by housing starts above 1,400,000 units annually), a monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the housing sector, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST declines in a housing-driven expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
